newsitem.title: UK: Blair names new UK Cabinet Secretary.
newsitem.headline: Blair names new UK Cabinet Secretary.

text.p: Sir Richard Wilson, Permanent Secretary at the Home Office, is to succeed Sir Robin Butler as Britain's Cabinet Secretary from next January, Prime Minister Tony Blair's office said on Friday.
Butler, who has held the post since 1988, is due to retire.
In a statement, Blair said Wilson, who will also be head of the Home Civil Service, will be a "modernising force in preparing the civil service for the challenges of the 21st Century."
"He will be making sure we make greater use of new technology, both to serve the people and for more effective communication between departments," Blair added.
